verdicts.reason: A drops the white logo panel, so the dark logo sits almost invisibly on navy. Its 'Ships late June' note is crushed into an illegible sliver beside the CTA, and the body copy is jammed against the right edge, leaving the left third mostly empty except for a tiny eyebrow. B keeps the logo on its white panel with the eyebrow underneath, and groups the CTA with its ship note, so it reads cleanly left to right. B still needs work: the four-line headline is dense, the body copy is too small to read at banner size, and the CTA is pressed close to the top edge.
